d:
The Knicks defeated the Cavaliers, 109-97 tonight in Cleveland. Jalen Brunson finished with a team-high 31 points along with 9 assists and 6 rebounds for the Knicks, while Karl-Anthony Towns tallied 29 points, 13 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Donovan Mitchell recorded 37 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Knicks improve their record to 5-4 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 5-5 for the season.
